notes: www2.hm.com/en_us/index.html, www.hm.com and the US shipping page all returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch on 2026-10-29. One try each, no workaround. A human must open the US store for status, known_for, dress prices, sizes, shipping and returns (see human_check in pages/h-m.json).

H&M Group's own brand page (hmgroup.com/brands/hm/) states the business idea as 'fashion and quality at the best price in a sustainable way' and says H&M has about 3,000 stores in 70 store markets and 50 online markets. Suggested known_for for the human check (the line is 7 words, over the 6-word limit): 'Fashion and Quality at the Best Price'.

hmgroup.com/about-us lists the group's brands: H&M, COS, Weekday (with Cheap Monday and Monki), & Other Stories, ARKET, Singular Society and Sellpy. COS, & Other Stories and ARKET are H&M Group sister brands.

Wikipedia: founded by Erling Persson in 1947 as Hennes, first shop in Västerås, Sweden; headquartered in Stockholm; first US store on Fifth Avenue, New York, 31 March 2000; listed on Nasdaq Stockholm.
